Bug Title: Biometric Login Displays an Unclear Error When Switching Users
Preconditions: Biometric login is enabled for an existing user on the device.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enable biometric login for User A.
2. Sign out or switch accounts.
3. Attempt to log in as User B using the biometric login flow.
4. Observe the displayed message.
Test Data: User A with biometrics enabled; a different account, User B.
Expected Result: The app should handle the account mismatch safely and display a clear message explaining that biometric login is associated with another account, with guidance to use the correct credentials or reconfigure biometric login.
Actual Result: An inappropriate or unclear error is displayed when attempting to log in as another user.
Evidence/Notes: Review biometric-to-account binding and ensure the message does not expose sensitive account information.

Module/Screen: Security – Sign Out of All Devices
Bug Title: Active Device Count Remains Unchanged After Signing Out All Devices
Preconditions: User has multiple active device sessions and can access the trusted devices/session screen.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the active devices or trusted devices screen.
2. Note the active device count (reported as 2).
3. Select Sign Out of All Devices and complete the confirmation.
4. Log in again.
5. Reopen the active devices screen and review the count.
Test Data: Account showing 2 active devices before sign-out.
Expected Result: All previous sessions should be revoked. After the next login, only the newly created/current session should be counted, unless the product intentionally counts another valid session.
Actual Result: The screen initially shows 2 active devices. After signing out of all devices and logging in again, it still shows 2 active devices.
Evidence/Notes: Verify server-side session revocation, device registration, and active-session count refresh. Confirm whether the current login is included in the count.
